summary:
SolarShield is a React + TypeScript web dashboard that makes space-weather data easier to understand for students and general users.

Main features
- Overview dashboard showing:
  - Solar flares
  - Coronal mass ejections (CMEs)
  - Geomagnetic activity
  - Awareness level and possible technology impacts
- Live Activity Lab for simulating future space-weather conditions using:
  - Current conditions
  - CME arrival
  - Solar flare bursts
  - Forecast horizon and sensitivity control
Learn section explaining solar flares, CMEs, and geomagnetic storms.
- Searchable and filterable recent-event table.
- Live refresh and fallback-data notifications.
- Interactive Three.js astronaut/space visualization.

Data sources
The dashboard retrieves:
- NASA DONKI event data
- NOAA SWPC planetary Kp index
- NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day metadata
details:
SolarShield is a web-based space-weather monitoring dashboard designed to make NASA and NOAA scientific data easy to understand.

It tracks:

  • Solar flares
  • Coronal mass ejections
  • Geomagnetic storms
  • NOAA Kp index
  • Possible effects on radio, GPS and satellite systems
